[h1]Changelog FCS “New Season #19 FREE Update”[/h1]

[b]News, improvements and updates[/b]

[u]1. New database of the season 2018/2019 [/u]
Made possible thanks to the enormous work done by football journalists along with FCS players. All of them have collaborated with our FCS team providing with their passion for football, data and statistics. 

A team led by Gaby Ruiz, ESPN journalist and professional scout of Leeds United. 

You’ll have all this at your disposal:

[b]#7 domestic leagues[/b], including first and second divisions of the following leagues: England, Spain, Germany, Italy, France, Mexico and Argentina.

[b]#37 domestic and continental competitions (+1)[/b] from Europe and America. 

[b]#568 teams (+57)[/b] from 49 countries all around the world. 

[b]#15.077 players (+2.057) [/b]from 149 different nationalities and determined by more than 285,000 parameters. 

[u]2. Updates in competitions 2018/2019[/u]
[b]New calendar 2018/2019[/b]
We have implemented the season 2018/2019 calendars to all the 37 competitions included in FCS.

[b]Adjustments in the Supercopa de España[/b]
Not without controversy among the supporters, this season the Supercopa de España has been played on a single-match format in an international stadium (it might be changed again in the future). 

[b]Adjustments in the Argentinean league [/b]
In the season 2018/2019, only 26 teams will play in Primera instead of 28 and therefore, the league will consist of 25 match days instead of 27. 

[b]New Copa Super (Argentina)[/b]
The Copa Super will be implemented for the first time and it will be held once the Primera División league is over. 

This competition will have the following format: 
- First Division  top 6 teams will directly qualify to the Round of 16.
- The remaining 20 teams will play a qualification play-off of a single match on a neutral stadium.
- The final will be held on a neutral stadium. 

[u]3. New Real MOD FCS NS#19 PCFutbolmanía[/u]
[b]Completely updated[/b]
Thanks for the work of the PCFutbolmania Community, we can enjoy the first version of Real MOD FCS NS#19 (more than 400 MB) including players, teams, logos, trophies, sponsors and more than 6,000 pictures of players. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12177077/c88820e5048a1a11e223354ade3499fa0abf6152.jpg[/img]

[b]Extra information about MOD download and installation [/b]
Version after version, the contents are more complete. That’s why we have implemented new information so you can estimate the remaining download time.

[u]4. Your opponents becomes 3 times stronger with the new AI
Your opponent’s strategy reaches a new level in FCS. [/u]
[b]The new AI is much stronger than in previous versions.[/b] It will be able to choose from a [b]3 times wider range of options while setting line-ups and strategies.[/b] Your opponents will always make use of the most effective line-ups available. 

Additionally, depending on the quality of both, your opponent’s and your players, [b]AI’s teams will prepare the match in different ways,[/b] being more defensive if your team is superior or going all-attack if your team is weaker. 

[u]5. The transfer market speeds up [/u]
A new algorithm will make sure this is possible.

All the teams will work hard to have a [b]squad as complete and competitive as possible.[/b] Their moves on the market will be more aggressive and will happen more often. 

[b]6. Teams will not let their stars leave easily [/b]
The algorithm used for helping the teams to keep their players is also brand new. 

The [b]probability of making a player staying[/b] while the team is trying to renew his contract [b]has increased.[/b]

Factors like age, quality or position will condition this probability. 

[u]7. Rotations are important but starts can be unhappy when they do not play.[/u]
It is the daily life of a coach. [b]AI new algorithm will determine the level of happiness based on the player’s quality and his eagerness to be played from the first minute.. [/b]

A ratio between the number of matches where the player is involved and the matches he has not seen a single minute of since the beginning of the season (or since the moment the player is signed) will be counted. The games where the player is not available (injuries, bans) will not be taken into consideration. 

[b]Based on the player’s quality and the number of games without involvement, the player will let us know his discomfort.[/b] The stars might complain first but other players from the squad might follow. 

You might receive messages from the players like “I do not understand why the coach does not take me into consideration” [b]thanks to the implementation of the new “Thoughts” system.[/b]

[u]8. Logos completely visible [/u]
Every screen showing team lists (Statistics, Standings, Calendar, Results…) will show now the [b]whole team logo[/b] and the team name will have a bigger size.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12177077/0b69c53cb9ad3673ccc3bfd0212f05ed9cabc131.jpg[/img]


[h1]Implemented suggestions from the Community and fixed bugs [/h1]

[b]1. IA teams should sign quality free players more often [/b]
“I often see players of great quality (for example, Pogba, level 89) whose contract with Manchester United expires (weird but can happen). After that, the unbelievable happens: no team signs him during a whole season. This would be impossible in real life and should be adjusted in the game.” [h1]Implemented.[/h1]

[b]2. The notification after finalising the works at your stadium should be improved [/b]
“When the works at the stadium finalise, you receive a message. So far, so good. However, it would be great if that message will include a direct link to the Stadium menu.” [h1]Implemented.[/h1]

[b]3. The distribution of the red cards is a bit off [/b]
“I am happy with the red card average during a whole season. However, I think the strikers receive way too many compared to real life. Ideally, central defenders should receive most of the red cards, followed by defender backs, goalkeepers and midfielders, followed by wingers and strikers.”  [h1]Implemented.[/h1]

[b]4. Could you add the player’s names to every play in Highlight mode? [/b]
“When your team scores a goal or receives a card in Highlights mode, you can see which player is the protagonist. I would like that to happen also when the player has a goal opportunity even if he misses. I think that would make the game more real. [h1]Implemented.[/h1]

[b]5. Crash error while saving the game. [/b]
“I have been playing the last version and everything seems to work fine until the moment when I try to save my game. At that stage, I receive time to time a crash error message. I have tried in my office’s computer and at home and I get the same error message.” [h1]Fixed.[/h1]

[b]6. Bug in the Supercoppa Italia [/b]
“On the last version, the Supercoppa Italia is only played by Juventus while it should be Juventus vs Milan. As Milan does not appear, Juventus plays against a free-agent players team.” [h1]Fixed.[/h1]

[b]7. Entering the screen “President” for the first time is very slow [/b]
“The first time I load a game and go to the President menu, it takes ages to load. It happens only the first time, after that, everything is fine.” [h1]Fixed.[/h1]

[b]8. The goals for the cup and the continental competitions are not shown in the “President” menu [/b]
“The President screen shows you only the league goal but not the cup and continental competition goals. These should be added.” [h1]Fixed.[/h1]

[b]9. Supporter’s and board’s evaluations do not match with the graphic[/b]
“The President screen shows the evaluations from the board and the supporters. They are shown in two ways, on a graphic where you can see the evolution during the season and the figure. These two do not match, it can be that the graphic shows 7 but the figure shows only 6.”  [h1]Fixed.[/h1]

[b]10. Highlights mode is not affected by a goalkeeper being sent off [/b]
“If your keeper is sent off while playing in Highlights mode, you can press Continue and resume the match without a keeper. You should receive the same error message as in Results mode indicating that you proceed without a keeper.” [h1]Fixed.[/h1]

[h1]Changelog FCS 18 “Final Race Update”[/h1] 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12177077/eb23ee7090262ee14e0a2b4dc2c0c0027e479f14.jpg[/img]

[u]Implemented suggestions from the Community[/u]

[b]1. New players algorithm [/b]
[i] “The new players appearing after the current players retirement have a very low level, sometimes even below 40. These players should be as good as the real ones and get better year after year as it happens in reality”.[/i] [h1]Implemented.[/h1] 

[b]Further details:[/b]
We have set up a new algorithm based on histograms: 

https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Histogram

Each histogram represents the frequency of player’s levels depending on their field position on each of the leagues and divisions in Football Club Simulator - FCS 18.

For example, these are the histograms of different positions:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12177077/ad87fdd8a4503d101425a1bf522b3731a2f7bbf1.jpg[/img]

By assigning the players the level based on these histograms, we know for sure that we maintain the level of the players and the leagues season after season.  

The algorithm takes into consideration the retiring player’s nationality as well so the amount of players for each country remains the same. 

Now it is time to implement this update and test it. We will be adjusting the algorithm with the help of your comments and feedback until it works to perfection. 

[b]2. Improvement in the waiting time between fixtures[/b] 
[i] “Since FCS 17 the waiting time between screens have been reduced and it would be great if this tendency can be kept”.[/i] [h1]Implemented.[/h1] 

[b]Further details:[/b]
The optimisation of the searching algorithms used by the IA-controlled teams, in special in the areas related to the new hirings, allows us to improve the game.

When searching for a player with specific skills in the database, the average searching time will be directly proportional to the database size. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12177077/9864a64a2d08ff83f82ff46ea08d4dcc5abe2a0f.jpg[/img]

However, if the database is divided in different slots and a map is created in order to locate the right slot for each time fast enough, the searching time is drastically reduced. This is how the new FCS 18 database #FR18 with HashMap works. 

We have also compared FCS 17 and FCS 18 waiting times while using as a parameter the most common PC among Steam players (4 CPUs and speed from 3.3 Ghz to 3.69 Ghz as registered in the last survey of April 2018):

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12177077/d7c5350bdcfb4233f334ca6ed8f1527f68e3c8e8.jpg[/img]

This is the comparative times in seconds:

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12177077/0031b3c8f5f0b0cb0febdc48523b3c52bc70121b.jpg[/img]

Since the beginning of the season, we have achieved a reduction of around 18% on waiting times. We are on a good path. 

Still, we will keep working on the reduction of waiting times for the new FCS 19. We’ll keep you updated! 

[b]3. More information between fixtures[/b]
[i]“Currently, transition screens between fixtures don’t give you any information (next match information, for example) so it makes you wonder if the game is loading or has crashed instead. It would be great to receive any information while you wait”.[/i]  [h1]Implemented.[/h1] 

[b]Further details:[/b]
We have created the “Loading and Info” screen with the following elements: 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12177077/4665c99da2f3fe16dd5085021a36d5660d79ab30.jpg[/img]

1. Loading symbol indicating that the process is on.
2. Trophy, name and flag of the competition of the following match.
3. Next fixture to be played.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12177077/9afdfe84e3afeed1f78242ea35e06476a55bada5.jpg[/img]

We can include further information which you might find useful. 

[h1]Share your ideas with us!!![/h1] 

[b]4. New database including the winter transfer window [/b]
[i]“It would be great to play with up-to-date squads: the new signings from the winter transfer window, the leagues with different transfer systems…”[/i]  [h1] Implemented.[/h1] 

[b]Further details:[/b]
We have updated the players database focusing on the following three goals: 

a) Include the winter window signings of each team and the new free players.

b) Include the signings of teams in leagues like Brazil and China with open transfer windows. 

c) Make FCS database bigger by adding more teams and players. After this update, more than 30 teams and 700 players will be added.

The new players replacing the retiring ones are quite bad. These new players should have similar ratings to those who retire. [u]Implemented[/u] 

[b]2. New age ranges in Scouting[/b]
The search function would improve if the following ranges were implemented. From 15 to 19 years / from 20 to 24 years / from 25 to 29 years / from 30 to 34 years / from 35 years onwards. [u]Implemented.[/u] 

[b]3. Promising talents[/b] 
It would be very useful to have the assistant coach informing you on a monthly basis if any of your young talents is overperforming In the Football School, Additionally, it would be great if the assistant coach could report about good players in your Youth Squad who are not yet training. [u]Implemented.[/u] 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12177077/2ca4ae9cceb95e3d704bad983144ff1a43ccb81f.jpg[/img]

[b]4. More rotation[/b] 
The AI does not rotate the line-ups so sometimes the stars of the rival teams are too tired and that penalises the team. This should be improved for the CPU teams. [u]Implemented.[/u] 

[b]5. Form affecting the tiredness algorithm[/b] 
Tiredness would be more realistic if not only the number of matches played consecutively and the minutes played in each of them are taking into account but also the current form of the player. This would imply that the better the player’s form is, the slower the player tires. [u]Implemented.[/u] 

[b]6. Quick action in one-week injuries[/b] 
If a player has a one-week injury, the medical team should treat him so he is fit for the next game. [u]Implemented.[/u] 

[b]7. Adjustments of the tiredness of new signings[/b]
While it is normal that the signing of a new player implies extra tiredness, the level now is too high. It should be reduced so he can play from the first match. [u]Implemented.[/u] 

[b]8. Winning bid[/b]
In the cases where you receive more than one bid for one of your players, it would be useful that once you accept one of them, the rest of the bids are automatically removed. The game would gain in dynamism and clarity. [u]Implemented.[/u] 

[b]9. Form in Football School after summer break[/b]
When the new season starts, the quality loss of the young talents is too high. They are young so it should be easier for them to keep the form. [u]Implemented.[/u] 

[b]10. Search by nationality[/b] 
I’d definitely implement a new search option: nationality. It would be really useful for us Argentinians as our squads can only have 5 foreign players. It would be useful as well in leagues like the English or the German, where the squad must have a minimum of national players. [u]Implemented.[/u] 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12177077/92107dd251c96a89e7674ef78af038552a85b725.jpg[/img]

[b]11. More options in specific training[/b] 
I’d like to have more slots for the specific training of my players. With a one-star training coach, I have six slots. This is clearly not enough. Also, with the best of the training coaches, I cannot train all my players simultaneously. I think one-star coaches should come with at least 11 slots and a five-star coach should let you train all the squad at the same time. [u]Implemented.[/u] 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12177077/12ba88c4e53319e6befbabface147e715f09b664.jpg[/img]

[b]12. Better end-of-the-match ratings[/b]
The ratings at the end of the match could be more realistic if it took into account the performance based on the most important skills for each position along with the quality difference between the two teams. [u]Implemented.[/u] 

[b]13. Statistics of all leagues[/b] 
I love the statistics menu. It helps me in situations like choosing the tactics for important games or making transfers based on the information of the players and teams of my league. However, I would include the statistics of all the rest of leagues. [u]Implemented.[/u] 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12177077/01030422c5b6685fdc3a2f4d3e420546b28176e4.jpg[/img]

[b]14. Signed player message[/b]
If a player will sign for a new team in the next transfer window, it should be reflected on his profile (for example, in the section where the button “Sign” appears now. [u]Implemented.[/u] 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12177077/67e7da1c82e3cd0a8455bf519b93448085876216.jpg[/img]

[b]15. Message when the works in the stadium are finished[/b] 
Making the stadium bigger is one of my favourite options of the game. I just miss a message that informs me once the works are done. [u]Implemented.[/u]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12177077/ac0b74e0a2bc5917811e0c13823a9342cfdfa3b2.jpg[/img]

[b]16. Improvement in the message “There is an interesting player”[/b]
It would be very useful if the message informing you that there is an interesting player is not removed even after you enter his profile so you can monitor him closely for the period of time you decide. The only way to close that message should be clicking the CLOSE button. [u]Implemented.[/u]

[b]17. New message about player wanting to get a better contract[/b] 
When a player has a salary which does not correspond with his quality, the game should let you know that he wants to either renew his contract or leave the team. Logically, if there is no agreement for a new contract, his performance will not be as good as usual. [u]Implemented.[/u] 

[b]18. New message about injuries[/b] 
I would implement a new message alerting you when one of your players has suffered an injury. [u]Implemented.[/u] 

[b]19. New message about players being fit again[/b]
Along with the previous message, the doctors should announce when the players are healthy again and ready to train and play.[u]Implemented.[/u] 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/12177077/80fc0c95a76a0269a43d328e0f44d72d6e92ac20.jpg[/img]

[b]20. New rules for foreign players in Argentina[/b] 
Since January 2018, there is a new rule in Argentina. The clubs can sign up to six foreign players and up to five of them can play simultaneously (before this law, only 4 could play at the same time). It would be fantastic if this could be implemented in the game. [u]Implemented.[/u]


[u]Reported bugs by the community already fixed:[/u]

- Sometimes some players lose their skills very early in their careers (even at 27!). At that age, I think they should be still improving and not otherwise. [u]Fixed.[/u]

- Sometimes, during the summer transfer window, I do not receive any offer for the players from my club listed in the transfer list. However, when the summer transfer window closes, offers start to pop up. [u]Fixed.[/u]

- I had to play Barcelona in the third match of the preseason when actually I need to play them again in the Supercopa de España days later. [u]Fixed.[/u]

- When an “interesting player” appears, it is usually the same player and almost every time is just a free-agent player. It would be good to have more variety. [u]Fixed.[/u]

- In 2017, currently a match is set to play on Sunday December 31st. This is not adjusted to real life where there are no matches in Italy, Spain or France. Please adjust. [u]Fixed.[/u]

- The free-agent players are not signed instantly. [u]Fixed.[/u]

- In the “Injuries” screen, the form level is not readable. [u]Fixed.[/u]

- In the Highlights mode, when a player is injured, there is no message alerting you of this situation so you can not make the substitution. [u]Fixed.[/u]

- The players being substituted off the pitch are not rated. [u]Fixed.[/u]

- When playing this game, my computer overheats and I need to use a cooling system. [u]Fixed.[/u]

- Something strange happened to me. I noticed that some players on loans are at the same time transfered. The game does not allow your club to sign any loaned player but CPU clubs can and this should not be possible. [u]Fixed.[/u]

- The foreign player rule in Argentina only applies to your club. Only your club is obliged not to play 5 foreign players at the same time and not to include 6 of them in your squad. But for what I have seen, the rest of clubs can have as many foreign players as they wish. [u]Fixed.[/u]

- The Community Shield is played in the local team’s stadium. In real life, this match is played at Wembley. [u]Fixed.[/u]

- The two Mexican Supercopas are played in the local team’s stadium. This competition is always played in a neutral field, either in Mexico or USA with a crowd capacity of at least 20 000 people. [u]Fixed.[/u]

- Keepers in every league are displayed correctly in the statistics screen but not yours, even if he has played 70% of the matches. [u]Fixed.[/u]

- When playing with the manual training option on, once you get rid of one player taking part of your training plan, the AI resets the training as if the automatic training option was on. [u]Fixed.[/u]

- The loans are not saved. If you accept a loan for a player, when you load your game, the loan is not active. [u]Fixed.[/u]

- I played Barcelona in the first leg of the Supercopa de España and they have made their three substitutions. In the last minute of the match, Umtiti has suffered an injury and Semedo has entered the pitch, becoming the fourth substitution. This should not happen, they should have played with only 10 players for the remaining part of the match. [u]Fixed.[/u]

- Sometimes, in the Highlight mode, the AI has made a substitution taking an injured player off the bench. Even if they are on the bench, the AI should never choose injured players. [u]Fixed.[/u]

- You should not play twice the same team in preseason. For example, playing with Real Madrid, I have played Werder Bremen both in the first match and in Trofeo Bernabéu. [u]Fixed.[/u]

- Sometimes, when the rival keeper is sent off, the AI replaces him with a keeper from the bench and the team keeps playing with eleven players. When a keeper or a defense in the CPU team is sent off, the team should play with 10 players using a more defensive plan and adapt the players and tactics to the new situation. [u]Fixed.[/u]

notes.title: July FCS 17 Update (v3.4.1.1) made from Football Club Simulator - FCS 17 player's suggestions: Real time squad planning and new rival AI.
notes.notes:
Afterward the release of Football Club Simulator - FCS 17 on June 2nd we keep on working for improving the videogame [b]teaming up with worldwide FCS gamers community.[/b] 
 
Do not hesitate to write us with your ideas: mail@footballclubsimulator.com

We count on you all to achieve successfully [b]FCS 18[/b] (v3.5) including [b]new season 2017 / 2018 free DLC[/b] targeted for early September. 
 
[h1] Real time squad planning  [/h1]
Having the best squad is key in order to achieve the Club's objectives.
 
And this is the reason why we have expanded up to five tabs that give you information about how to plan your squad:
[list]
[*]Current squad 
[*]Additions
[*]On loan
[*]Winter Market
[*]Next season
[/list]
Now you have perfectly clear the players you have at your disposal. The ones you have, the ones you are going to have, which ones are on loan and what your team will be in both the winter and next season markets.
 
You can also keep track of your transferred players, to know how they are doing, if they improving, if they are playing...
 
The real-time control of the squad knowing in detail the squad you have and the squad you'll have is an essential help to set your priorities at the time of transfer. 

[h1] New rival AI  [/h1]
In every game, your opponent will choose the game plan and the balance that best outcome offers to deal with your team and your tactics.
 
The AI will also undertake the best starters for each game plan, it will review and perform rotations and, among all the possible combinations, opt for the one offering a higher RTA.
 
If you play against an inferior rival, it will seek to close lines and place more defensive players. If on the other hand, you play against a top team, it will accumulate players in offensive positions to play the attack.
 
In short, the new IA of your rivals enhances the gaming experience by making it more realistic and challenging. 

[h1] Suggestions from the Community [/h1]
“It would be nice to have the data of fatigue when performing a substitution” Implemented.
 
“The search criteria by age of the scout is 17 to 19 years. Having watched this season signings, it would need to be expanded from 16 to 19”  Implemented.
 
The notice of "unanswered" should appear only in the "aggressive" offers that pay the clause and therefore that might end up taking the player. Implemented.

[h1]  Bugs reported by the Community [/h1]
“On certain occasions, when search with the scout has been performed, the game has not been able to continue” Corrected.
 
“I receive the message "Not enough players" but I have do have enough players in the squad” Corrected.
 
“The number 0 dorsal appears to be available and it shouldn't be because it is not regulatory” Corrected.
 
“In the middle of a game, you can press the + button of Personalised Training. It would be necessary to lock the button in these cases” Corrected.

notes.title: New price, new offer of 50% and new free main update made with the suggestions of the Football Club Simulator - FCS players.
notes.notes:
We have been working together with the Football Club Simulator - FCS community for the last twelve months preparing a main update driven by the gamers suggestions.
 
Now it's finished, and it's what we all wanted. And it's integrated with SteamWorks!!!
 
We have set in €10 the new official price of Football Club Simulator - FCS and launched a 50% offer coinciding with the Final of the football season. 
 
This is the summary of the most important improvements and innovations that we've been including with all of your suggestions:
 
[h1]Football Club Simulator - FCS 3.4.1 + DLC w17 + Mod 17 PCFutbolmanía[/h1]

 
[h1]1. General[/h1]
[b] 1.1 UI improvements[/b]
We have expanded the screen area dedicated to key data by more than 20% using graphics rather than text to be able to easily access the essential information to make the best decisions at a glance.
 
[b] 1.2 XML Data structure[/b]
The videogame's closed data structure has been replaced by an open and standardized XML format. Stability, therefore, has been improved immediately, and the Community will be able to Mod the game easier and faster than ever.
 
[b] 1.3 Optimized performance[/b]
The code and its bottlenecks have been optimized especially in competitions, with 40% improvement in performance that has reduced to only 24 seconds daily and up to 105 seconds between season and season.

 
[h1]2. Competitions[/h1]
[b] 2.1 2016/2017 Season updated[/b]
This update comes with the DLC w17, updated with the winter transfers on January 31st of the seven countries with playable teams: Spain, England, Germany, Italy, France, Mexico, and Argentina.
 
And of course, also players from more than 30 countries with teams you can face in different competitions.
 
[b] 2.2 SteamWorks[/b]
You also have SteamWorks to share and play with Mods created by the community all over the world. In addition to now having an XML data structure, creating Mods will be faster and more effective than ever. 
 
[b] 2.3 Mod 17 PCFutbolmania[/b]
"Native" FCS Mods have arrived, with XML data structure and 100% compatible. The first one is the Mod 17 of PCFutbolmania and is now available. It is a great step forward. 

 
[h1]3. Playstyle[/h1]
[b] 3.1 Lineup with real-time training[/b]
The Lineup includes all the essential data: position, role, dorsal, name, nationality, skills, fitness condition, average, moral, tiredness, real-time average, average per position, age, play level, trophies ...
 
And as a novelty, the listing is interactive and allows you to decide in real time the most appropriate training for each of your players in just a few seconds. Try it. It is really useful. 
 
[b] 3.2 New tactics and formations editor[/b]
Choose between the favorites of the best coaches in the world. You have seven predefined ones at your disposal. Use the simple and powerful editor to create your custom tactics and save it for your key matches. You have up to 5 "slots" for you to test your formations. 
 
[b] 3.3 New markings[/b]
The screen "See rival" evolves into "One-on-one defense". You can study your rival and compare the average quality, the offensive and/or defensive balance and skills, fitness condition, morale and fatigue of each of his players. And here comes the key moment to decide which player or players you need to assign a one-on-one defense to "stop them" during the match. 

 
[h1]4. Market and signings[/h1]
[b] 4.1 Official and real-time transfers[/b]
The official transfers" mode has no limits of negotiation. As in real football, you can negotiate with players and teams throughout the season, incorporating the players only during the official windows:
 
Summer window = July 1st to August 31st.
Winter window = January 1st to January 31st
 
Also in Football Club Simulator - FCS you have exclusive of the "Real-time transfers mode". An agile, demanding and fun system, where you can sign, but also "'lose" players throughout the season. Dare to try it?...
 
[b] 4.2 New market system and signings[/b]
Average, age, position, the difference of objectives of the competing teams ... absolutely everything is contemplated in the new salary calculation algorithms, clause, and transfer value to give the transfer and player market great realism.
 
[b] 4.2 Football school[/b]
The youth team becomes an authentic "School of football" where you can train and study the evolution of the young players day by day and discover young promising players. If you spend time preparing and selecting players, it won't be long until you discover its advantages. For each young promising player you discover, the money you'll save in signings, the potential of sports results and the income increase will not just increase but it'll go through the roof!!!

 
[h1]5. Club and Stadium[/h1]
[b] 5.1 New distribution of TV rights[/b]
Finally, the majority of competitions have already agreed to a more fair system for the distribution of TV rights and similar in the major European football leagues. The system is now available in FCS and you can check how it increases the competitiveness in "Primera división" and provides greater liquidity to "Segunda división", which really needed it.  
 
[b] 5.2 Assistant coach and coaching staff[/b]
Your collaborators are integrated into specialized staff and all of them together is your new "Coaching staff". It will not be cheap. But it will be essential to achieve your goals. If you know how to manage them, it won't be a loss. It will be your biggest investment.
 
[b] 5.3 Extra funding for the stadium expansion[/b]
The improvement and expansion of your stadium is key to strengthen your finances and achieve your goals. Up until now, the works were paid by the bank, the deadlines were short and, of course, with "annoying" interests. 
 
The question for any Club owner is inevitable. How can I improve this situation?... Simple, if the manufacturer wants the contract, he will have to accept new deadlines for payment delayed until after the works have ended...

notes.title: Football Club Simulator - FCS 4.0.2.1 = Focused on stability. Update now available!!!
notes.notes:
The FCS 4.0.2.1 version of Football Club Simulator is focused on getting the best stability of the videogame and the competitions included.

To do this we have counted with the invaluable help of thousands of players from the International Community of FCS.

Players from Brazil to Germany, from England to Russia and from Spain to all countries of Latin America.

Without your reports, saved games, DxDiag and dump files it wouldn't have been possible to achieve such an improvement in so little time.

[b]Many thanks to all.[b]

[i]Nataly Stefano[i] - [url=] https://www.facebook.com/nataly.stefano [/url]
[b]Worldwide CM[b] - The Football Club Simulator Studio 


[b]STABILITY[b]

[b]General:[b]

1.Fixed the "marking" by default of the country in the drop-down list of the player selection window.

2. Fixed the automatic alignment which now, if required, chooses youth players in replacement of injured and/or cautioned players.

3. Fixed the message when renewing your own player.

4. Limited to three the number of goalkeepers that a computer controlled team can handle.

5. Fixed the error at the end of the first season when playing in Pro-Manager mode.

6. Fixed the error when selecting a team at the end of season in Leagues of countries with "Cup 2": England, France, Mexico and Argentina.

7. Fixed the error when displaying the offers tab in the transfers window.


[b]European competitions:[b]

1. Fixed error when performing the group draw of the European Cup.

2. Fixed the error when ordering the groups of the Europa League.

3. Fixed the error when performing the draw of the round of 16 of the Europa League.

4. Fixed the error when getting the number of available places for non EU-Players.

5. Fixed error in the schedule of the english league so two matches aren't played on the same day.

6. Fixed error in the spanish Cup so the away and home games of the round of 16 aren't played both in the same stadium.

7. Fixed the error in the day 33 of the League of Italy that allowed to play two games in the same day.

8. Fixed the error of positions in the classification of the League of France concerning the Europa Cup and the Europa League.

9. Fixed the error in the name of the player "Rena" of the team "Paris" who appeared with incorrect characters.


[b]American competitions:[b]

1. Fixed the error in the schedule of the League of Mexico at the end of the regular season in the Apertura and Clausura tournament which allowed two games on the same day to be played in the promotion and relegation "Play-Offs"

2. Fixed the line-up in the trophies of the 1st and 2nd division of Mexico.

3. Fixed the qualifying of the best second team to the round of quarterfinals of the Mexican Cup.

4. Fixed the name of the player "Oliver" of the team "Mexico City" with incorrect characters.

5. Fixed the line-up in the Trophy of the 1st. division of Argentina.

[b]IMPROVEMENTS[b]

[b]1. Counter-Offers to players in last year contract. Emotion in the signing until last minute[b]

A new algorithm for the signing of players in the last year of contract manages and takes into account up to six variable for the calculation of a possible counter-offer and retention of the player by his current team:
 
The variables are the following: 
1. Signing offer
2. Clause offer.
3. Age of the player
4. Quality of the player
5. Average quality of the current team.
6. Average quality of your team.

[i]Note: Try it out and give us your opinion to adjust it and improve it.[i]
[i]Write to Nataly Stefano: mail@footballclubsimulator.com[i]

[b]2. All or nothing. The promotion and relegation Play-Offs are here for Mexico and Argentina[b]

Now we are risking the season in the field. And there is no need to rely on a "confused" calculation of averages of classification in the last 4 years.

The "Play-Offs" in real time are finally here, where the emotions get high when gambling the promotion and/or the relegation in the leagues of Argentina and Mexico. Get the victory in the field and not through bureaucracy.

In addition, we have updated the names of the groups to "Apertura", "Clausura" and "Final" so that everythign is clearer. And also the name of the competition "South Cup" which created a lot of questions, for the "Liberty Cup" one.

[b]3. Get the maximum performance of your team. Manage foreigners and non-EU players up to the limit allowed[b]

FCS already manages the official boundaries of foreigners in Argentina and Mexico and the non-EU players in Europe. Both the total in team as the total in the field.

This way, you will have clear how to do the line-up and the signings throughout the season in order to have the most competitive team.

[i]Note: There are still some errors to find in player with double nationality. If you find any player in this situation, send us a "screenshot" and we will fix it right away.[i]
[i]Write to Nataly Stefano: mail@footballclubsimulator.com[i]
